indicator_contract.native: RSI14 -> EMA14 minus EMA60 -> signal EMA5; StochRSI14/14/3/3
indicator_contract.parity_blocker: Research and application initialization/EMA conventions differ; canonical owner and actual Pine fixture must adjudicate before market evaluation.
indicator_contract.normalization: Native RSI-MACD in oscillator units or past-only own-history rank; price MACD may separately be divided by price ATR.
indicator_contract.missing_values: Explicit policy and sufficient observed history; no silent neutral fill or future interpolation.

clock_design.anchoring: NYSE regular session anchored at 09:30 America/New_York; retain and identify final short bars; exact calendar for holidays/early closes.
clock_design.diagnostic_control: Equal session partitions, e.g. 130m/195m, and matched physical EMA half-life are artifact checks, not extra automatic winners.

trend_pullback.description: Continuation only inside contemporaneously constructive structure; not a universal stock label.
trend_pullback.draft_context: Previous completed daily close above its SMA50; SMA50 above its value five completed sessions earlier.
trend_pullback.draft_location: Setup-timeframe low touches or crosses its EMA20, while setup close remains above its EMA50. Freeze this before market evaluation; it may miss the shallowest leaders.
trend_pullback.price_only_trigger: Two confirmed one-bar-right-side swing lows on the execution timeframe; the second is higher. Fix the intervening swing-high neckline when the second low becomes confirmed. First subsequent completed close above that neckline qualifies.
trend_pullback.momentum_ablation: Add native RSI-MACD histogram rising for two completed setup-bar transitions; compare with price-only on all eligible opportunities.
trend_pullback.not_required: No automatic daily RSI<30 requirement; no requirement to know an eventual future 3D TAKE label.

sweep_reclaim.description: A reversal at support identified before the sweep.
sweep_reclaim.draft_reference: Lowest low of the preceding 20 completed setup bars, excluding the candidate bar.
sweep_reclaim.draft_setup: Candidate low below the frozen reference and candidate close above it.
sweep_reclaim.price_only_trigger: After setup is known, a completed execution bar closes above the sweep bar high; require no intervening break of the sweep low. A next-bar hold variant is a separate tested entry, not a backdated label.
sweep_reclaim.momentum_ablation: Add native histogram improvement or StochRSI cross separately, not as three independent votes.
sweep_reclaim.not_required: No retrospective anchor at the best-looking later low.

event_base_repair.description: Acceptance after information-related repricing; not a claim the event can be forecast.
event_base_repair.draft_event_definition: Known timestamped material announcement OR an opening gap at least two pre-event daily ATRs. Threshold is a test definition, not optimized evidence.
event_base_repair.draft_reference: Anchor at the first regular-session trade after the known event; fix the first completed 60-minute range and an event VWAP. Trade-level VWAP preferred; OHLCV typical-price VWAP must be labeled proxy.
event_base_repair.price_only_trigger: Two completed 60-minute closes above the event reference and first-hour high, followed by a retest that stays above the established base low. Compare immediate second-close entry and retest entry as distinct policies.
event_base_repair.risk_units: Record pre-event ATR, current ATR and raw dollar invalidation distance; do not make the event look safer by renormalizing solely with shock-inflated ATR.
event_base_repair.not_required: No hindsight exclusion of events whose prices never recovered.

execution_contract.eligibility: All contributing observations must be available; use existing confirmation_date where applicable and prove required bucket closure.
execution_contract.entry: Next executable execution-bar open after confirmation; include latency/spread, gap and nonfill handling.
execution_contract.setup_expiry: One full regular session of elapsed trading minutes after a tactical setup becomes known; proposed frozen starting definition.
execution_contract.stop: Structural low associated with the actual setup; gap fills may be worse. No model-generated capital sizing.
execution_contract.path_ambiguity: Use finer data or conservative stop-first classification when both boundaries occur in the same OHLC bar.
execution_contract.opportunity_cost: Report missed entries, capital occupancy, time stopped out and re-entry cost.

validation.first_stage_cells: 3 families x 3 setup frames x 2 execution frames = 18 literal primary cells, shared across names. No unrestricted per-ticker parameter search.
validation.parameters: Freeze oscillator lengths; choose only within training. Record every tried arm, including failed variants.
validation.holdout: Chronological and leave-name/leave-event-out evaluation. JNJ and LLY are already inspected diagnostic names, not pristine holdouts.
validation.previously_seen_history: Do not describe a period already used in prior research as untouched merely because this script did not execute on it.
validation.purge: Exclude training episodes whose outcome intervals overlap validation/test; embargo follows actual maximum label/holding window, not an arbitrary universal number.
validation.uncertainty: Resample calendar/event blocks with all correlated names kept together; show per-name counts and effective episode counts.
validation.compare: Same opportunities and exits while changing entries; same entries while changing exits. Fixed-horizon diagnostics are not realized trading returns.
validation.selection_metric: Pareto assessment of adverse excursion, shake-outs, entry delay, opportunity recall and net expectancy; do not maximize one win-rate number.
validation.promotion: No market winner without source/data/causality parity, costs, held-out stability and prospective evidence.
validation.prior_rejected_work: Do not revive a rejected regime/exit router from a few attractive examples; source drift does not invalidate archived findings by itself.

stocks.incremental_question: Does price acceptance add more than forcing a deep oversold oscillator reading?
stocks.special_caution: A persistent uptrend would make repeated oscillator-top exits expensive; test that cost, do not assume the trend exists.
stocks.falsifier: Reject the shallow-pullback hypothesis if it does not improve adverse excursion and opportunity capture versus the price-only entry.
stocks.exit_assessment: Keep the incumbent exit during entry comparisons; quantify premature exit followed by re-entry cost.

stocks.primary_family: Trend reset with a confirmed higher low
stocks.incremental_question: Does a shallow momentum reset enter strong continuation episodes better than waiting for deep daily oversold?
stocks.special_caution: Do not pool routine pullbacks with materially negative announcement gaps.
stocks.falsifier: Reject the faster trigger if apparent price improvement is outweighed by stop-outs, execution cost or missed delayed confirmations.
stocks.exit_assessment: Distinguish extension from failure; test profit protection without assuming every RSI extreme is a top.

stocks.incremental_question: Does the additional hold/retest reduce false entries enough to compensate for paying a later price?
stocks.special_caution: Separate ex-dividend price mechanics, ordinary consolidation and event-related repricing.
stocks.falsifier: Reject an extra oscillator filter if the same structural entries perform equivalently without it under matched opportunities.
stocks.exit_assessment: Test failed breakout plus support loss; keep risk warnings separate from mechanical sells.

stocks.secondary_family: Ordinary trend pullback in constructive structure
stocks.incremental_question: Can a tradeable local repair be identified without claiming the larger downtrend has ended?
stocks.special_caution: A local bounce and a durable reversal are different labels; no automatic claim that MRK is currently weak.
stocks.falsifier: Reject repair entries that mostly fail below overhead resistance or only appear good after conditioning on a later recovery.
stocks.exit_assessment: Treat overhead supply as an exit-reference candidate, not an automatic permanent price target.

stocks.incremental_question: Can acceptance above an event-defined reference distinguish durable repair from a reflex bounce?
stocks.special_caution: Use a pre-event risk ruler as well as live ATR; a shock must not make the same dollar risk look artificially smaller.
stocks.falsifier: Reject the event-repair variant if its edge disappears when all qualifying shocks, including never-recovered cases, are included.
stocks.exit_assessment: Keep gap exposure distinct from stop distance; do not infer a guaranteed stop fill.

stocks.incremental_question: Does the pullback rule generalize beyond a small number of event episodes?
stocks.special_caution: Flag announcement windows separately.
stocks.falsifier: Reject an advantage driven by one episode or one extreme gap.
stocks.exit_assessment: Fixed incumbent exit for entry ablations.

stocks.incremental_question: Does momentum add information after location and acceptance are already required?
stocks.special_caution: A range hypothesis must be based on current observable structure.
stocks.falsifier: Reject redundant momentum votes with no incremental out-of-sample effect.
stocks.exit_assessment: Measure repeat exits in a sustained grind.

stocks.incremental_question: Does local structural recovery justify an entry before long-term averages recover?
stocks.special_caution: Do not turn a weak-structure hypothesis into a permanent ticker label.
stocks.falsifier: Reject bounce entries that cannot overcome nearer overhead resistance.
stocks.exit_assessment: Distinguish a tactical bounce exit from a long-term trend top.

stocks.incremental_question: Does reclaim acceptance improve entry quality beyond an oversold crossover?
stocks.special_caution: Segment event and non-event episodes.
stocks.falsifier: Reject results dominated by exposure reduction or a single repricing.
stocks.exit_assessment: Common exit first; no ticker-specific exit optimization.

stocks.incremental_question: Does a slower trigger reduce adverse excursion without losing too much move capture?
stocks.special_caution: Use peer context appropriate to the instrument rather than assuming XLV alone explains it.
stocks.falsifier: Reject extra confirmation if it merely chases the same move at a worse location.
stocks.exit_assessment: Evaluate support breach and later recovery cost separately.

stocks.incremental_question: Which entry family matches observed structure in the training period?
stocks.special_caution: Do not share an event calendar or earnings assumptions with another device name.
stocks.falsifier: Reject family selection that reverses in held-out periods.
stocks.exit_assessment: Retain one fixed exit across entry comparisons.

stocks.incremental_question: Does longer-context repair distinguish sustained recovery from short bounces?
stocks.special_caution: Use a tools-oriented peer comparison, not an insurer or drug-company template.
stocks.falsifier: Reject gains that vanish after shared-cycle episodes are grouped together.
stocks.exit_assessment: Measure dead time and opportunity cost as well as losses.

stocks.incremental_question: Does the TMO-derived hypothesis survive on this held-out name?
stocks.special_caution: Evaluate dependence with related tools names rather than counting their simultaneous signals as independent.
stocks.falsifier: Reject a supposed cross-stock validation that is only one common sector episode.
stocks.exit_assessment: Common exit and equal opportunity windows.

stocks.incremental_question: Does a faster trigger capture a higher low without multiplying shake-outs?
stocks.special_caution: Growth-trend behavior must be observed, not assumed from company identity.
stocks.falsifier: Reject the faster entry if benefits disappear after spread/slippage and failed setups.
stocks.exit_assessment: Separate an overbought warning from a structurally justified exit.

stocks.incremental_question: Does the same growth-pullback construction transfer from the diagnostic names?
stocks.special_caution: Keep source-of-move and event flags explicit.
stocks.falsifier: Reject an isolated best parameter with poor neighboring settings.
stocks.exit_assessment: Keep the original exit while varying entry timing.

stocks.incremental_question: Does price acceptance outperform a stand-alone StochRSI cross?
stocks.special_caution: No claim of a presently intact uptrend.
stocks.falsifier: Reject increased churn without a lower adverse-excursion distribution.
stocks.exit_assessment: Quantify missed continuation after warning-based exits.

stocks.incremental_question: Does the technical setup retain value outside binary-event windows?
stocks.special_caution: Known scheduled events and unscheduled surprise risk remain different.
stocks.falsifier: Reject a rule whose success requires retrospectively excluding bad events.
stocks.exit_assessment: Gap risk is not removed by a structural stop.

stocks.incremental_question: Does an event-reference reclaim improve outcomes across multiple unrelated events?
stocks.special_caution: Do not transfer LLY momentum assumptions without evidence.
stocks.falsifier: Reject performance dominated by one catalyst or one reversal.
stocks.exit_assessment: Use event-consistent price references and realistic gap fills.

stocks.incremental_question: Does the UNH event-repair hypothesis transfer to another payer-related name?
stocks.special_caution: Shared-event correlation must be grouped; company exposures are not identical.
stocks.falsifier: Reject an effect that disappears under leave-one-event-out checks.
stocks.exit_assessment: Keep event gap exposure explicit.

stocks.incremental_question: Does the shared rule survive a different business mix?
stocks.special_caution: Do not treat payer and pharmacy-benefit news as interchangeable.
stocks.falsifier: Reject a peer filter that merely restates the stock through a heavily self-weighted benchmark.
stocks.exit_assessment: Common exit, not a provider-specific regime router.

stocks.incremental_question: Does repair acceptance help across distinct company-specific and group-wide episodes?
stocks.special_caution: Diversified exposures require event tags rather than one permanent peer label.
stocks.falsifier: Reject a strategy that only works after the successful recoveries are selected.
stocks.exit_assessment: Tactical repair exit and long-term top remain separate.

stocks.incremental_question: Does the rule work without importing insurer economics into hospital behavior?
stocks.special_caution: Use a provider-appropriate benchmark and event taxonomy.
stocks.falsifier: Reject validation based only on pooled healthcare returns.
stocks.exit_assessment: Report trade duration and capital tied up in failed recoveries.

stocks.incremental_question: Does the general family transfer outside the main drug/device/payer clusters?
stocks.special_caution: Treat this as a cross-sectional check, not a forced fit to the five diagnostic names.
stocks.falsifier: Reject isolated ticker tuning unsupported by the shared family.
stocks.exit_assessment: Common exit and explicit re-entry analysis.
